title: Sofie-babes and Ismael
text:
Sofia and Ismael were incredible hosts for the nightclub bar crawl! They kept the energy up all night, made sure everyone was having a blast, and really went above and beyond to make the experience unforgettable. Super friendly and fun – you can tell they love what they do. Definitely made the night!

The only thing I didn’t enjoy about this bar crawl was Sofia’s loud annoying English accent, she really does love the queen!!! 
I think it added hugely to my sore head the morning after, other then that she is an amazing girl and made the night lots of fun with her great craic
author: oisinof

title: Amazing event
text: Amazing events, I highly recommend! I have been to two of them one organized by Ismael and the other by Nadia, both were fantastic. Party was great and the organizers were caring, fun and professional!
author: 421cailinv

title: Nadia is the best and Barcelona really gets lit!!
text: This was such a spectacular night out! The hostel I was staying at let me know about this pub crawl and at around 8:30 pm there was a pub crawl guide in the lounge area hyping people up and giving out free welcome shots! I signed up after meeting the guide, Nadia, because she was so fun a friendly. She was an expert at getting us around and knew exactly where to go to get lit on a Tuesday night. That's right, I went out on a TUESDAY and it was so lit I was out until 5:30a and I was one of the first to leave the last club! title: Great pub Crawl
text: My partner and I stayed at Casa Gracia and decided to join the pub crawl after having great conversation with Nadia. She was great and also gave us great suggestions on what to do in Barcelona. On the night we went out, we had a great time. We had welcome shots at the 2 first bars we went. It was a great way to meet people and get into the popular night clubs.
